rics.description: All Car Sales - Acutal
rics.meaning: Total Car Sales — passenger cars only (excludes light trucks). The shrinking part of the auto market.
rics.how_to_use: Cars dropped from ~50% to ~25% of light-vehicle sales since 2010. EV adoption is reshaping the car segment specifically (Tesla, Rivian, Lucid). Truck SAAR (aUSVHLS − aUSCARSOA) is the larger and more cyclical segment.

rics.description: All Truck Sales
rics.meaning: All truck sales (light + heavy).
rics.how_to_use: Trucks = ~75% of light-vehicle sales now (CUV + pickup mix shift).

rics.description: Motor Vehicles, Auto unit imports, Canada
rics.meaning: Auto unit imports from Canada — passenger vehicles imported from Canadian plants. Canada is integrated with US auto manufacturing under USMCA.
rics.how_to_use: Track for USMCA trade flows. Canadian plants produce primarily for US export (Honda Alliston, Toyota Cambridge, GM Oshawa). Tariff threats (2018, 2025) directly impact this series.

rics.description: Motor Vehicles, Car sales, domestic passenger
rics.meaning: Domestic passenger car sales — cars assembled in US/Canada/Mexico (USMCA). Excludes vehicles imported from Asia or Europe.
rics.how_to_use: Track domestic vs imported share for trade-policy implications. Tariff regime changes show up here first. Domestic share has fallen as Asian OEMs shifted to US assembly (Toyota, Honda, Hyundai, Kia all have major US plants).

rics.description: Motor Vehicles, Car sales, domestic passenger
rics.meaning: Domestic passenger car sales — annual aggregate of cars assembled in USMCA region. Companion to aUSDCAR at lower frequency.
rics.how_to_use: Use for long-term-trend analysis of domestic-vs-imported auto mix. Domestic car share has fallen as Asian OEMs shifted to US assembly (Toyota, Honda, Hyundai, Kia all have major US plants).

rics.description: Motor Vehicles, Car sales, imported passenger
rics.meaning: Imported passenger car sales (annual) — vehicles imported from outside USMCA region. Companion to aUSICAR at lower frequency. Mostly European luxury and Japanese/Korean supplements.
rics.how_to_use: Sensitive to tariff policy and currency moves. Watch USDJPY and EURUSD for currency-pass-through. Section-232 tariff threats specifically target this category.

rics.description: Motor Vehicles, Car sales, imported passenger
rics.meaning: Imported passenger car sales — vehicles imported from outside USMCA region. Mostly European (German luxury, UK premium) plus some Korean and Japanese supplements to US production.
rics.how_to_use: Sensitive to tariff policy and currency moves. EU tariff changes (proposed 2018-19, 2025) directly hit this series. Watch USDJPY and EURUSD for currency-pass-through to import-vehicle prices.

rics.description: Motor Vehicles, Car sales, total
rics.meaning: Total car sales (passenger sedans, hatchbacks, sports cars — excluding light trucks/SUVs). Has structurally declined post-2010 as US shifted to SUV/CUV preference.
rics.how_to_use: Cars are now ~25% of light-vehicle sales (was 50% in 2010). Track separately from trucks for demand-mix signal. EVs are mostly classified as cars in this data; rapid EV growth partially offsets ICE-car decline.

rics.description: Motor Vehicles, Car sales, total
rics.meaning: Total car sales (annual) — sum of domestic + imported passenger cars. Companion to aUSNCAR at lower frequency.
rics.how_to_use: Annual frequency cleaner for trend analysis. Cars now ~25% of US light-vehicle market (was 50% in 2010). EVs included as cars in this data; track separately for EV-specific share.

rics.description: Motor Vehicles, Domestic auto unit inventory
rics.meaning: Domestic auto unit inventory — outstanding stock of unsold vehicles at dealer + manufacturer level. Days-supply ratio (inventory/daily sales rate) is the cleaner stress signal.
rics.how_to_use: Pre-COVID norm ~60-90 days supply for cars, ~80-100 for trucks. 2022 supply shock saw <30 days; rebuilding now toward normal. Watch for inventory build above 100 days as a sign of demand softening.

rics.description: Motor Vehicles, Domestic auto unit inventory, inventory level (Ward's)
rics.meaning: Domestic auto unit inventory levels — alternative measure to aUSPCARRVO/A. Same underlying inventory concept at different frequency/release.
rics.how_to_use: Cross-check against aUSPCARRVO/A. Days-supply ratio (inventory/daily sales) is the meaningful stress signal — under 30 days = tight, over 100 = loose. Watch alongside production for the inventory-build-or-draw signal.

rics.description: Motor Vehicles, Domestic auto unit production
rics.meaning: Domestic auto unit production — vehicles assembled in US plants. Companion to sales for the supply-side picture.
rics.how_to_use: Inventories = production minus sales over time. Track for supply-discipline signal: when production exceeds sales, inventories build and OEM incentives rise. Chip-shortage 2021-22 caused production crater while demand persisted, driving used-car prices and CPI.

rics.description: Motor Vehicles, Total light trucks sales
rics.meaning: Total light truck sales (SUVs + pickups + minivans). ~75% of US light-vehicle market. Higher-margin segment for OEMs.
rics.how_to_use: Pickup truck demand correlates with construction and small-business activity (most pickups go to commercial buyers). Pickup-vs-SUV split useful for B2B vs consumer breakdown. Larger segment sees biggest dealer-incentive moves.

rics.description: Motor Vehicles, Total light trucks sales
rics.meaning: Total light truck sales (alternative source) — same conceptual measure as aUSTSALE/CA at different release vintage.
rics.how_to_use: Cross-check against aUSTSALE/CA. Use whichever has fresher data. Light truck mix is the structural story of US auto market: from 30% of mix in 1990 to 75% today.

rics.description: Motor Vehicles, Total light vehicle sales
rics.meaning: Total light vehicle sales (annualized) — companion series to aUSVHLS at quarterly/annual frequency. Same conceptual measure for long-time-series comparison.
rics.how_to_use: Cross-check against aUSVHLS. Use the higher-frequency series for monthly tracking. Long-term trend has shifted from cars (sedan-dominated 1990s) to trucks/SUVs (~75% of mix today).

rics.description: Motor Vehicles, Total light vehicle sales
rics.meaning: Total light-vehicle sales (cars + light trucks) at seasonally-adjusted annual rate. Released monthly (Wards Auto / Autodata).
rics.how_to_use: The headline US auto-sales print. Pre-COVID norm ~17M SAAR; supply-chain shock dropped to 13M in 2021-22; recovering toward 16M. Major demand input to GDP (consumer durables) and to inflation (used-car CPI is auto-sales-volume driven).

rics.description: Motor Vehicles, Truck Sales, Heavy trucks sales
rics.meaning: Heavy truck sales.
rics.how_to_use: Class 8 trucks — freight-cycle indicator. Order books lead by 6-9 months.

rics.description: Motor Vehicles, Truck Sales, Heavy trucks sales
rics.meaning: Heavy truck (Class 8) sales — semi-tractors, cement mixers, dump trucks. Sold mostly to fleet operators and trucking companies. ~250-450k units/year.
rics.how_to_use: Pure cyclical indicator: trucking demand → fleet replacement → orders. Sustained drops below 350k SAAR have preceded freight recessions. ATA's truck tonnage index is the demand-side companion.

rics.description: Motor Vehicles, Truck Sales, Heavy trucks sales
rics.meaning: Heavy truck (Class 8) sales — alternative source. Cross-check with aUSTKHSAO/A. Pure cyclical indicator: trucking demand → fleet replacement → orders.
rics.how_to_use: Use whichever is fresher. Sustained drops below 350k SAAR have preceded freight recessions. ATA's truck tonnage index is the demand-side companion.

rics.description: Motor Vehicles, Truck sales, domestic light
rics.meaning: Domestic light truck sales — companion to aUSDTRUCK/A. Captures pickups + SUVs assembled in US/Canada/Mexico under USMCA.
rics.how_to_use: Watch for nearshoring effects. Production has shifted from Mexico for some models, expanding US assembly. Track alongside aUSMVTSIMPL for full domestic-vs-imported truck mix.

rics.description: Motor Vehicles, Truck sales, domestic light
rics.meaning: Domestic light truck sales (annual aggregate) — companion to monthly truck sales at lower frequency. USMCA-region production.
rics.how_to_use: Use for long-term-trend analysis. Domestic-vs-imported share key for trade-policy implications. Pickup trucks dominate this category.

rics.description: Motor Vehicles, Truck sales, imported light
rics.meaning: Imported light truck sales (annual) — non-USMCA-sourced light trucks. Mostly Asian and European origin.
rics.how_to_use: Smaller share than imported cars because tariffs on imported pickups (25%, 'chicken tax') have historically protected US pickup makers. Subject to tariff-policy risk.

rics.description: Motor Vehicles, Truck sales, imported light
rics.meaning: Imported light truck sales (alternate source) — same conceptual measure as aUSMVTSIMPL/A.
rics.how_to_use: Cross-check series. Use whichever is fresher. Tariff-protected category historically.

rics.description: AUTODATA RETAIL SALES OF NEW CARS: DOMESTIC (AR)
rics.meaning: Autodata Retail Sales of New Cars: Domestic (Annualized Rate) — Autodata Corp's measure of domestic-only car sales (USMCA-assembled passenger cars only).
rics.how_to_use: Track for domestic-vs-import retail mix. Autodata is a primary source automakers report through; J.D. Power and Wards aggregate their data.

rics.description: Motor Vehicles, Total light vehicle sales (Autodata Corp.)
rics.meaning: Total light vehicle sales (Autodata Corp) — alternative provider's measure of the same total light-vehicle sales. Useful for cross-check when source data revisions diverge.
rics.how_to_use: Autodata is the source most automakers report through. Compare against Wards Auto-sourced series to see methodology differences. Major divergences are usually corrected within 1-2 months.

rics.description: United States, REUTERS POLL: DOMESTIC CAR SALES - ACTUAL, Volume, Automobiles & Transport, Monthly, Reuters
rics.meaning: Reuters Poll: Domestic Car Sales — Actual — Reuters survey-based estimate of monthly domestic car sales, used pre-release as forecast benchmark.
rics.how_to_use: Used by markets to anchor expectations before official release. Comparison vs actual print drives short-term auto-sector trades.

rics.description: United States, REUTERS POLL: DOMESTIC TRUCK SALES - ACTUAL, Volume, Automobiles & Transport, Monthly, Reuters
rics.meaning: Reuters Poll: Domestic Truck Sales — Actual — Reuters poll-based estimate. Markets use as forecast benchmark before official monthly release.
rics.how_to_use: Survey-anchored estimate. Comparison vs actual print drives auto-sector reaction. Domestic truck sales matter for domestic-OEM share (Ford F-150, Chevy Silverado, Ram).

rics.description: United States, REUTERS POLL: TOTAL VEHICLE SALES - ACTUAL, Volume, Automobiles & Transport, Monthly, Reuters
rics.meaning: Reuters Poll: Total Vehicle Sales — Actual — Reuters total-vehicle-sales survey estimate, anchor for monthly release expectations.
rics.how_to_use: Most-watched of the Reuters auto polls. Comparison vs actual print drives broad auto-sector trades. ~17M SAAR = healthy; <14M = stressed.

rics.description: Air Cargo Traffic, Available Ton Miles
rics.meaning: Air cargo available ton miles.
rics.how_to_use: Cargo capacity. Spread to revenue ton-miles = utilization (load factor).

rics.description: Air Cargo Traffic, Revenue Freight Ton Miles
rics.meaning: Air cargo traffic, revenue freight ton-miles — total air freight activity at US airports. BTS monthly release.
rics.how_to_use: Cyclical: tracks goods trade and e-commerce demand. Spiked 2020-21 during pandemic e-commerce surge. Watch alongside trucking and rail freight for full freight-cycle picture.

rics.description: Air Passenger Traffic, Available Seat Miles
rics.meaning: Available seat miles — capacity.
rics.how_to_use: Industry capacity. Pairs with passenger miles for load factor.

rics.description: Air Passenger Traffic, Revenue Aircraft Hours (Airborne)
rics.meaning: Air passenger traffic, revenue aircraft hours (airborne). BTS monthly. Captures fleet-utilization for passenger flights.
rics.how_to_use: Tracks passenger-flight activity. Recovered fully from COVID by 2024. Watch for capacity discipline post-recovery (airlines avoiding overcapacity).

rics.description: Air Passenger Traffic, Revenue Aircraft Miles Flown
rics.meaning: Air passenger traffic, revenue aircraft miles flown — total miles flown by passenger aircraft. Companion to aircraft-hours.
rics.how_to_use: Tracks long-haul vs short-haul mix. Long-haul international has lagged domestic in COVID recovery. Watch alongside aircraft-hours for trip-length signal.

rics.description: Air Passenger Traffic, Revenue Departures Performed
rics.meaning: Air passenger traffic, revenue departures performed — number of passenger flights operated.
rics.how_to_use: Tracks total flight count. Combined with passenger enplanements gives load-factor implications. Departure count is more frequency-driven; enplanements more demand-driven.

rics.description: Air Passenger Traffic, Revenue Passenger Enplanements
rics.meaning: Air passenger traffic, revenue passenger enplanements — total passengers boarding flights. The 'how many people flew' number.
rics.how_to_use: Cyclical with leisure + business travel demand. TSA security throughput is the high-frequency complement. Watch for peak-summer-travel season trends and post-COVID business-travel recovery.

rics.description: Air Passenger Traffic, Revenue Passenger Miles, U.S. carriers
rics.meaning: Revenue passenger miles, US carriers.
rics.how_to_use: Combines headcount with stage length. The headline air-travel demand metric.

rics.description: Air Passenger Traffic, Total Revenue Ton Miles
rics.meaning: Air passenger traffic, total revenue ton-miles — combined passenger + cargo ton-miles. Captures total revenue-generating activity.
rics.how_to_use: Aggregate aviation activity gauge. Watch for overall airline industry health. Decompose into passenger vs cargo for source of growth/weakness.

rics.description: Overall, Transportation Services Index, Freight
rics.meaning: Transportation Services Index — Freight component.
rics.how_to_use: BTS combined freight gauge: trucking, rail, water, pipeline, air freight. Leads industrial production.

rics.description: Overall, Transportation Services Index, Passenger
rics.meaning: Transportation Services Index, passenger — BTS composite of passenger transportation activity (air, rail, transit). Released monthly.
rics.how_to_use: Real-time passenger-transportation pulse. Combined with freight-side TSI gives total-transportation cycle gauge. Useful as a coincident-economy indicator.

rics.description: Overall, Transportation Services Index, Total
rics.meaning: Transportation Services Index — Total.
rics.how_to_use: BTS combined transport activity (passenger + freight). Leading indicator.
